title: 3D Ultrastructural Visualization of Mitosis Fidelity in Human Cells Using SBF-SEM
author: Nuria Ferrandiz
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: Fetal bovine serum (FBS) (Sigma, catalog number: F
MatTek gridded glass-bottom culture dishes (MatTek Corporation, catalog number: P35G-1.5-14-CGRD) Fugene HD transfection reagent (Promega, catalog number: E
Sample processing Sodium phosphate dibasic (Na 2 HPO 4 ) (Sigma, catalog number: S
Sodium phosphate monobasic (Na HPO4) (Sigma, catalog number: S
Tannic acid, low molecular weight (Electronic Microscopy Science, catalog number:
Agar 100 premix kit-Hard (Agar Scientific, catalog number: R

steps.title: Prepare cell culture medium
steps.instruction: Use DMEM/F‑12 Ham supplemented with 10 % FBS, 2 mM L‑glutamine, 100 U mL⁻¹ penicillin/streptomycin, and 0.26 % NaHCO₃; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Seed cells on gridded dishes
steps.instruction: Detach RPE‑1 GFP‑Sec61β cells with trypsin‑EDTA and seed ~90 000 cells per MatTek gridded glass‑bottom dish 24 h before the experiment; aim for ~60 % confluency on imaging day.

steps.title: Optional transfection
steps.instruction: 48 h before the experiment seed ~25 000 cells, add Fugene HD at a 3:1 ratio (3 µL Fugene to 100 µL OptiMEM), incubate 5 min RT, add 1 µg plasmid DNA, incubate 20 min RT, then add mixture to cells; incubate 12–16 h, wash next morning and replace with full medium.

steps.title: Optional drug treatment
steps.instruction: Treat cells with 150 nM GSK923295 for 3 h, then wash off 1 h before imaging to allow entry into mitosis.

steps.title: Optional synchronization
steps.instruction: Block with 2.5 mM thymidine for 16 h, release for 6 h, then incubate with 9 µM RO‑3306 for 16 h; wash off RO‑3306 and wait 45 min before imaging. Stain chromosomes with 0.5 µM SiR‑DNA for 30 min before imaging.

steps.title: Live‑cell imaging and cell selection
steps.instruction: Image cells in full medium on a spinning‑disc confocal (e.g., Nikon CSU‑W1) at 20× or 60×; record brightfield position on the photo‑etched grid for the chosen mitotic cell.

steps.title: Immediate fixation after imaging
steps.instruction: Add fixation buffer (2.5 % glutaraldehyde, 2 % paraformaldehyde, 0.1 % tannic acid in 0.1 M phosphate buffer, pH 7.4) directly to the dish while still on the microscope; incubate 1 h, then replace with fresh fixative after 1 min.

steps.title: Wash post‑fixation
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with 0.1 M phosphate‑buffered saline (PB) for 5 min each; samples may be stored in PB up to 12 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Post‑fix with reduced osmium
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in freshly prepared 2 % reduced osmium (mix equal volumes of 4 % aqueous OsO₄ and 3 % potassium ferrocyanide) for 1 h at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Prepare 1 % TCH solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.1 g thiocarbohydrazide in 10 mL pre‑warmed dH₂O, incubate at 60 °C for 1 h with gentle swirl every 5–10 min; filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter before use.

steps.title: Wash after reduced osmium
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PB for 5 min each at RT.

steps.title: TCH incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in the freshly prepared 1 % TCH solution for 15 min at RT.

steps.title: Wash after TCH
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PB for 5 min each at RT.

steps.title: Second osmium incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in 2 % aqueous OsO₄ (not reduced) for 30 min at RT.

steps.title: Wash after second osmium
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PB for 5 min each at RT.

steps.title: Uranyl acetate staining
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in 1 % uranyl acetate (UA) solution (prepared from a filtered 20 % UA stock in methanol: dissolve 0.5 g UA in 2.5 mL methanol, filter, then dilute 0.25 mL of this stock into 5 mL dH₂O) for 16 h at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash after UA
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with dH₂O for 5 min each.

steps.title: Prepare lead aspartate
steps.instruction: Make 0.03 M L‑aspartic acid stock (heat 60 °C 60 min, filter). Add 66 mg lead nitrate to 9 mL of this stock, adjust pH to 4.5 with 10 N KOH, then bring volume to 10 mL and adjust pH to 5.5 with 10 N KOH; incubate 30 min at 60 °C in a glass vial.

steps.title: Lead aspartate incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in the prepared lead aspartate solution for 30 min at RT.

steps.title: Wash after lead aspartate
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with dH₂O for 5 min each.

steps.title: Ethanol dehydration series
steps.instruction: Dehydrate cells sequentially in 30 %, 50 %, 70 %, 90 %, and 100 % molecular‑grade ethanol, 5 min each.

steps.title: Resin infiltration
steps.instruction: Infiltrate with Agar 100 hard resin mixed with ethanol: (1) 1 part resin : 2 parts ethanol for 30 min; (2) 2 parts resin : 1 part ethanol for 30 min; (3) 100 % resin for 30 min.

steps.title: Resin polymerization
steps.instruction: Add fresh full resin to fill the MatTek dish to ~2 mm depth; polymerize for 24 h at 60 °C, then cool to RT.

steps.title: Detach coverslip
steps.instruction: Plunge the dish briefly into liquid nitrogen and use a razor blade to pry off the glass coverslip, exposing the resin surface and imprinted grid coordinates.

steps.title: Locate and excise cell block
steps.instruction: Using the brightfield grid image, mark the cell position with a marker pen, cut out the resin block containing the cell with a hacksaw, then trim to a ~200 × 200 µm block face using a glass knife on an ultramicrotome.

steps.title: Apply conductive coating
steps.instruction: Paint the trimmed block with silver conductive paste, then sputter‑coat with a 60 mm × 0.1 mm gold/palladium (80/20 %) layer.

steps.title: SBF‑SEM imaging
steps.instruction: Load the block into a Gatan 3View holder on a FEI Quanta 250 ESEM; relocate the cell using the light‑microscopy coordinates; acquire automated serial sections with a diamond knife, imaging at 8.8 nm × 8.8 nm (x,y), 60 nm (z) in a 4000 × 4000 pixel window until the whole cell is captured.

steps.title: Import data into Fiji
steps.instruction: Open the image stack via Bio‑Formats (or TIFF series), verify voxel size (adjust via Image > Properties if needed), optionally convert 16‑bit to 8‑bit, register the stack using SIFT (Plugins > Registration), enhance contrast (Process > Enhance Contrast, 1 % saturation, Normalize, Process All), optionally subtract a Gaussian‑blurred version, then save as a TIFF series.

steps.title: Segment structures in MIB
steps.instruction: Launch MIB, import the TIFF stack (Directory Contents > Combine Selected Datasets), set spatial parameters, optionally correct drift (Dataset > Alignment), create a segmentation model (63 or 255 classes), define four materials (chromosomes, mitochondria, ER, plasma membrane), and segment using Brush + Fill, Interpolation (draw every nth slice, press I), and Thresholding/Magic Wand as appropriate; save the model (Model > Save Model) and export contours (.mod) and volume (.mrc).

steps.title: Visualize in 3DMOD/IMOD
steps.instruction: Open IMOD, load the .mrc volume and corresponding .mod file, view the model (Image > Model View), mesh all objects (Edit > Object > Meshing > Mesh All), adjust display settings, then save rendered views as TIFF (File > Snap TIFF As) or create movies/montages as desired.
